**Daily Devotional**

**June 18**

*9 Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee. (Psalms 32:9 KJV)*

This is not saying that a horse or mule is dumb, as they are smart animals as they can be taught to do many things. The difference between them and people is that they do not have understanding. They cannot figure things out for themselves, but have to be taught before they can learn anything new. This verse is telling us not to be as a horse or mule, by not using our understanding of things, like an animal. A lot of people refer to this as common sense, and a person can have a college degree and know a lot of things, but without common sense they can not figure things out on their own, or how to put to use what they know. But if you have been born again, you have the very mind of Christ living in you (1 Corinthians 2:16).

So often us humans don’t use our minds properly and we go and commit sins that cause us and others much harm, all because we don’t use common sense, or understanding that what we do will cause so much harm. It is foolish to sin and give the devil an inroad into our lives (Romans 6:16), so that he can bring evil, such as sickness and disease upon us. God loves us even when we sin, as all our sins have been forgiven. But when we give the devil an opportunity to access us by sinning, we are just being like an animal, and not using our God given ability to understand what the results will be of our sin. Even though God still loves us, we are stupid to sin, as the devil only comes to steal, destroy and kill us (John 10:10). That is reason enough not to sin. Thank you Lord for all your warnings.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
